notes.title: Text Wormhole V1.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We would greatly appreciate if a variety of players could test it out.

Text Wormhole V1.10 Patch Notes:
--> Keyboard control sensitivity increase
--> There is no death judgment after the end of each round of the game
--> Added 2 players leaderboards
--> Game difficulty adjustment
--> The difficulty of the game was adjusted
--> Added QUOTE feature!

Thank you to everyone that has been playing so far. We really appreciate it.

-Elknight Team

http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30895002/3f2098b3edafe2274b4470b9b6c35fbf9ae217b7.png
